confirmHiddenText.description: Export even where words are hidden: the words a slide's edge, the end of a path or a table cell hides (`text-hidden`).

id.description: Fresh request identity. Movie cancellation matches this ID in the current window/session.

movie.description: Movie format only; omit to use the app’s default export settings.

output.description: Absolute path of a new file, or for png a new folder, outside any presentation folder: an export never replaces what stands there when it is asked, and never writes among a presentation's files.

codec.description: H.264 in an MP4, or Apple ProRes 4444 in a QuickTime movie; H.264 when omitted. The container follows from it.

resolution.description: Lines on the movie's shorter side: a landscape movie's height, a portrait movie's width; 2160 is 4K.

slideDelay.description: Hold each slide for this many seconds.

slides.description: Slides by the numbers the author knows them by, skipped slides left out; every shown slide when omitted.

stepDelay.description: Hold each completed step for this many seconds.

transparent.description: Leave slide backgrounds transparent; ProRes 4444 only.

AgentRequestId.description: A UUID the caller makes for its request, in either case.
